title: Amazing… but almost there!
body:
Reminders has gotten SO MUCH better the last few updates. If only they would allow 2 things:

1. To separate due date from deadline date so that we can work on things Today but these have a future deadline
2. To connect Calendar and Reminders so that one can optionally see particular tasks in calendar if so desired. Other 3rd party apps aren’t as good. 

PLEASE HEAR THIS OUT APPLE!
